Equipment

We ensure high quality and reliability through modern equipment and advanced technologies.

Welding Equipment

  • TIG (WIG) Welding Machines

    Allow obtaining high-quality welds when working with stainless steel, titanium alloys, and other materials requiring precise and careful welding.

    • Manual TIG (WIG) welding machines — for welding tubes, thin sheets, and parts with complex shapes.

    • Orbital welding — automated equipment for welding tubes with diameters from 6 to 115 mm and wall thicknesses up to 3 mm, ensuring high productivity and reproducibility of results.

  • MIG-MAG Welding Machines

    High-productivity machines for welding carbon and alloyed steels, as well as aluminum alloys. Ensure stable arc and uniform penetration, which is especially important when working with thicker wall thicknesses.

  • MMA (Shielded Metal Arc Welding)

    Traditional arc welding technology, necessary in the assembly of metal structures with large cross-sections, as well as in conditions requiring mobility or work in the open air.

  • Equipment for Gas Welding and Brazing

    Used for specific tasks such as brazing non-ferrous metals or small-series welding work requiring special precision and careful temperature control.

Machines and Equipment for Processing

  • CNC Machines for Metal Cutting

    (laser, plasma, or water — depending on needs) Allow obtaining precise parts with minimal deviations, which is especially important in the production of complex metal structures and technological pipeline components.

  • Lathes and Milling Machines

    (including CNC models) Ensure high precision in processing parts, flanges, fittings, and other pipeline system elements. Modern machines reduce production cycle time and ensure stable part quality in large series.

  • Bending and Rolling Machines

    Used for bending sheet metal and forming cylindrical or conical elements used in tank constructions and housing parts.

  • Drilling and Cutting Machines

    Help save time and ensure high reproducibility of holes and cuts in tubes, sheets, and structural profiles.

Equipment for Weld Preparation and Processing

  • Machines for Grinding and Polishing

    Allow bringing welds and metal surfaces to the required degree of cleanliness and smoothness, which is especially important in the food and pharmaceutical industries, where hygiene is important.

  • Systems for Pickling and Passivation

    Used when working with stainless steel, where it is necessary to restore corrosion resistance after welding and final processing.

Quality Control and Testing

  • Equipment for Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)

    • Ultrasonic Defectoscopes

    • Radiographic Systems for Weld Control

    • Penetrant Testing (PT)

    • Magnetic Testing (MT)


    All these methods help detect internal and surface defects in time, increasing the safety and reliability of structures.

  • Instruments for Geometry and Linear Dimensions Measurement

    Digital calipers, laser meters, precision gauges allow verifying the conformity of parts with drawings and tolerances.

Lifting and Transport Equipment

  • Cranes and Hoists

    Used for handling heavy sheet materials, tubes, and finished metal structures within the workshop.

  • Forklifts

    Ensure efficient logistics in the company, simplifying storage and transportation of products.

Why is it Important?

The use of modern CNC machines and certified welding equipment minimizes the possibility of errors, guaranteeing high final product quality.

Thanks to process automation, Weld Tech Group can efficiently execute orders, maintain stable quality, and meet short assembly and production deadlines.

A wide range of equipment allows us to work with various metals and alloys, including difficult-to-weld materials (titanium, aluminum, highly alloyed steels).

Our own production and welding-assembly base allows comprehensive solution of production tasks: from metal cutting and bending to final assembly and testing.
